package.name: aws_sdk_vendor
package.description: Vendor package for the AWS SDK for C++, fetched live from github.com/aws/aws-sdk-cpp at colcon-build time via ament_vendor() (VCS_TYPE git), pinned to a fixed version. Builds only the `s3` service client by default (the AWS_SDK_BUILD_ONLY CMake cache variable overrides this); zlib request compression is disabled (optional per the SDK), keeping the default build minimal. Verified working against RustFS (PutObject + multipart) before adoption by ros2_data_collection's Bridge Uploader.
